aggregation: one pick_place state pool; equal weight per state; pair tiers by full state_id
qualification: new task contacts/assets require nominal, vibration and replay requalification before Phase 09 measurement

pick_place.apple.friction_values_are: experimental contact coefficients for the phenolic tabletop, not measured material data
pick_place.apple.inertia_model: collision-geometry compile scaled to the design mass; visual and region geoms excluded
pick_place.apple.mass_values_are: per-object design masses, not density-derived compile values
pick_place.apple.stability_constraint: start pose is the measured free-settled rest pose; upright grasps close at or above the centre of mass, while the lying can is cradled below its axis
pick_place.apple.success_rule: majority of the collision geometry inside the crate footprint, resting on the crate floor, released; orientation and residual speed are reported but do not gate success
pick_place.apple.surface_model: flush rigid layer; fixed total worktable mass and top height
pick_place.apple.table_surface: light-gray phenolic worktable; the felt mat task was retired
pick_place.apple.target_container: single fixed crate shared by every variant
